description.fun: A ghostly black horse that probes its surroundings with every sense but sight. Its kicks are said to separate soul from body, and as it dashes through the night it absorbs the life force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude, though it can't resist a Shaderoot Carrot. It may take after the Pooka, a black faery horse of Irish legend.
description.guide: A Ghost-type Legendary Pokémon from The Crown Tundra and one of Calyrex's two steeds; Calyrex rides it as Shadow Rider Calyrex. It is the only pure Ghost type with no evolutionary relatives.
description.tagline: A ghost horse that steals the life force of sleepers
